title: Kevin Kiley comments on governance and policy decisions
text:
Kevin Kiley U.S. House of Representatives from California's 3rd district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Kevin Kiley U.S. House of Representatives from California's 3rd district | Official U.S. House Headshot
Kevin Kiley, a U.S. Congressman representing California's 3rd district, has recently taken to social media to express his opinions on state governance and policy decisions. Known for his active role in politics since 2023, Kiley has been vocal about various legislative issues.
On February 19, 2025, Kevin Kiley criticized Governor Gavin Newsom's decision to ban gas cars through executive action. He stated: "Gavin Newsom banned gas cars with a stroke of the pen. We are about to reverse that ban with a vote of the people's representatives."
Later that day, Kiley commented on what he perceives as Governor Newsom's inefficacy in implementing policies. He remarked: "Newsom's one saving grace is his total incompetence, which often trips up his efforts to destroy our state."
In another post dated February 20, 2025, Kiley reflected on the passage of time since Inauguration Day with the brief statement: "Tomorrow is Feb. 20. Inauguration was Jan. 20. What a difference a month makes."
